######ANALYSIS OF STROMAL SUBCLUSTERS:PERCENTAGE OF DONORS, AVERAGE EXPRESSION AND CORRELATION#########

#INSTALL PACKAGES

#1pacman

# installPACMAN
install.packages("pacman")

#2Install all CRAN packages

cran_packages = c(
  "Seurat", "SeuratData", "Matrix", "dplyr", "presto", "gprofiler2",
  "ggplot2", "patchwork", "gplots", "cowplot", "openxlsx", 
  "plyr"
)

install.packages(cran_packages)

#3-Install Bioconductor packages

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(c("DropletUtils", "scDblFinder", "BiocParallel"))

#LOAD THE PACKAGES

pacman::p_load(
  Seurat, SeuratData, Matrix, dplyr, DropletUtils, presto,
  gprofiler2, ggplot2, patchwork, gplots, cowplot, openxlsx,
  plyr, scDblFinder, BiocParallel
)

#THE working directory

#1-LOAD THE DATA

##load the data: from the initial code harmony2.rmd

stromal_obj = readRDS("data/process/temp/stromal_subset.rds")
table(stromal_obj$celltype)

#2-NORM, FVF, SCALE AND RUNPCA

set.seed(123)
##the same process
#normalize,scale, run_pca, findvarfeature
stromal_obj = NormalizeData(stromal_obj)
stromal_obj = FindVariableFeatures(stromal_obj)
stromal_obj = ScaleData(stromal_obj,vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
stromal_obj = RunPCA(stromal_obj)

#3-CHECK THE TRESHOLD FOR THE PCA AND THE RESOLUTION BEFORE FINDING THE CLUSTERS AFTER INTEGRATION.BASED ON DATA SIZE , WE CAN CHOSE A RANGE OF RESOLUTION

#use ans ELBOWPLOT:shows the variance explained by each principal component (PC).You use it to decide how many PCs to keep
ElbowPlot(stromal_obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca") +
  ggtitle("Elbow plot - Stromal sample")

#4-PERFORM INTEGRATION


##perform integration: no need to join layers###
library(harmony)
stromal_obj =RunHarmony(
  stromal_obj, 
  group.by.vars = "orig.ident",
  orig.reduction = "pca", 
  dims.use = 1:30
)
Reductions(stromal_obj) # to check harmony: run succesfully

#visualization
stromal_obj = RunUMAP(stromal_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
p1=DimPlot(
  stromal_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = c("sample"),
 label.size = 2, shuffle = T
)
p1

#5- PERFORM DIFFERENT RESOLUTION

#1 Build the nearest-neighbor graph (required before clustering)
stromal_obj <- FindNeighbors(stromal_obj, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")

#2 Create clusters at resolutions from 0.3 to 1.0
for (res in seq(0.1,1, by = 0.1)) {
  stromal_obj <- FindClusters(stromal_obj, resolution = res)
}

#3 Get all clustering resolution columns from metadata
res_cols <- grep("RNA_snn_res", colnames(stromal_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)


#4 Plot each resolution separately
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(stromal_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction =  "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
}

#5 (Optional) Combine all plots into one grid for comparison
library(patchwork)

plots <- lapply(res_cols, function(res) {
  DimPlot(stromal_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
    ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
})

wrap_plots(plots)

#5-1CLUSTERS NOW with the choosen resolution

### clusters after integration
stromal_obj = FindNeighbors(stromal_obj, reduction="harmony", dims = 1:30)
stromal_obj = FindClusters(stromal_obj, resolution =0.6, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")

#5-2PLOT FOR CLUSTERS

##plots with the clusters

library(RColorBrewer)

# Number of clusters
n_clusters <- length(levels(Idents(stromal_obj)))

# Create enough distinct colors
if(n_clusters <= 12){
  my_colors <- brewer.pal(n_clusters, "Paired")
} else {
  # For more than 12 clusters, interpolate a larger palette
  my_colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n_clusters)
}

# Set identities if not already
Idents(stromal_obj) <- "seurat_clusters"  # replace with your cluster column

# Plot
p = DimPlot(
  stromal_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  label = TRUE,
  label.size = 5,
  repel = TRUE,
  cols = my_colors
)+ ggtitle("STROMAL_Umap - Resolution 0.6")
p
#save
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/stromal_resolution.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8)

#6-FIND ALL MARKERS IN ALL CLUSTERS

##find all markers###########################
#first
all_markers_stromal <- FindAllMarkers(
  stromal_obj,
  only.pos = TRUE,     # only genes upregulated in each cluster
  min.pct = 0.25,      # minimum % of cells expressing the gene
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
# 2️⃣ Keep only significant markers
all_markers_stromal <- all_markers_stromal %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)

library(openxlsx)
# save (important)
write.xlsx(
  all_markers_stromal,
  file = "output/temp/all_markers_stromal.xlsx"
)

#6-1 LETS SEE IF THEY ARE STROMAL WITH THE MARKER : #FBN1 PCOLCE2 CD34 PLA2G2A SFRP2 C7 CXCL12 COL15A1 PTX3 TNFAIP6 CCL2 APOE APOC1 AGT CCL19 CCL8 CCL21 NDUFA4L2 HIGD1B TNFSF13B VCAM1 FDCSP CXCL13 CR2 SFRP4 WISP2 NOV MYH11 ACTA2 PLN

stromal_markers <- c("FBN1", "PCOLCE2", "CD34",  "PLA2G2A", "SFRP2","CXCL12", "COL15A1",  "PTX3", "TNFAIP6", "CCL2",  "APOE", "APOC1", "AGT",  "CCL19", "CCL8", "CCL21",  "NDUFA4L2", "HIGD1B",  "TNFSF13B", "VCAM1",  "FDCSP", "CXCL13", "CR2",  "SFRP4", "WISP2", "NOV",  "MYH11", "ACTA2", "PLN")
p=DotPlot(stromal_obj, features = stromal_markers, cols = c("lightgrey", "darkgreen"), cluster.idents = T, 
          group.by = "harmony_clusters") +
  RotatedAxis() + ggtitle("Expression of Known Stromal Markers Across Clusters")
p
#save
#ggsave(filename = "output/temp/stromal_markers_dot_plot.png", plot = p,width = 10, height = 8)

#7-THE NUMBER OF CELLS PER DONOR


#change colname 
stromal_obj$Donors = stromal_obj$orig.ident

#create the meta data
meta = stromal_obj@meta.data[, c("harmony_clusters", "Donors")]
table(meta$Donors)

#1-counts cells per donor
cell_counts_per_donor = as.data.frame(table(meta$Donors))
colnames(cell_counts_per_donor) = c("Donor", "CellCount")

#7-1PLOT

####

p <- ggplot(cell_counts_per_donor, aes(x = Donor, y = CellCount)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Donor, xend = Donor, y = 0, yend = CellCount), size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 5, color = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Cells per Donor (Stromal)",
    x = "Donor",
    y = "Cell Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
p

#save
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/Numb_STROMAL_cell_per_Donor.png", plot = p, height = 8, width = 10)

#8-THE PROPORTION OF DONORS IN EACH CLUSTERS

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)


# Make sure dplyr functions are used explicitly
meta = stromal_obj@meta.data

#the  percentage 
donors_counts = meta %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters,Donors) %>% #count cells each donor use in each cluster
  dplyr::summarise( n= dplyr::n(),.groups = "drop") %>% #numb of cells
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n /sum(n))  #fraction of cells per donor

#8-1 PLOT

#####
p <- ggplot(donors_counts, aes(
  x = harmony_clusters,
  y = proportion,
  group = Donors,
  color = Donors
)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  # Use a colorblind-friendly palette with distinct colors
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Donor") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Donor Proportion Across Stromal Clusters",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Proportion (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
p
#save the plot
#ggsave(filename = "output/temp/Proportion_donor_per_STROMAL_cluster.png", plot = p, height = 8, width = 10)

#9- the AverageExpression with markers genes(within clusters)

#1-EXTRACT THE MARKER GENES#####
library(openxlsx)
colnames(all_markers_stromal)

#select 
marker = all_markers_stromal[, c("gene", "cluster", "avg_log2FC", "p_val_adj")]
#remove duplicate
marker_genes = unique(marker)

#2-GET UNIQUE MARKER GENES
marker_genes = unique(all_markers_stromal$gene)

#3 filter MG
#all genes in rna assay
gene_in_stromal = rownames(stromal_obj[["RNA"]])

#only genes present in the object
marker_genes_filtered <- marker_genes[marker_genes %in% gene_in_stromal]

length(marker_genes_filtered)  # should be > 0

#4 averageEpression per cluster
avr_exp = AverageExpression(
  stromal_obj,
  features = marker_genes_filtered,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)

#3 to get the matrix 
avr_exp_matrix = avr_exp$RNA
dim(avr_exp_matrix)

#9-1-1PLOT

#plot
library(pheatmap)
p=pheatmap(
  avr_exp_matrix,
  scale = "row",
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  main = "Average Expression of Marker Genes per BEC_Cluster"
)
p
ggsave(
  filename = "output/temp/avr_stromal.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)

#10- THE CORRELATION

#1-correlation between clusters
#need numeric matrix
avr_exp_matrix = as.matrix(avr_exp$RNA)
#correlation
cluster_cor = cor(avr_exp_matrix,method = "spearman") # or spearman

#10-1 PLOT

#plots
p=pheatmap(
  cluster_cor,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  main = "Cluster Correlation based on STROMAL Markers Genes"
)
p

#to save
ggsave(file ="output/temp/cor_stromal.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

#11 ANNOTATION:USE THE CORRELATION AND THE DOTPLOT TO DO THE ANNOTATION

#BASED ON THE EXPRESSION OF MARKERS FROM #5 and the CORRELATION LETS ANNOTATE
new_ann = c(
  "0"="Inflammatory-Stromal-Cells(TNF-SC)", "1"="Smooth-Muscle-Cells", "2"="Inflammatory-Stromal-Cells(TNF-SC)",
  "3"="Fibroblast-like-Stromal-Cells", "4"="Adventitial-Stromal-Cells", "5"="Adventitial-Stromal-Cells", "6"="Pericyte",
  "7"="T-Zone-Reticular-Cells", "8"="Inflammatory-Stromal-Cells(TNF-SC)", "9"="Smooth-Muscle-Cells", "10"="T-Zone-Reticular-Cells", "11"="Marginal- Reticular-Cells", "12"="Follicular-Dendritic-Cells", "13"="Adventitial-Stromal-Cells"
)

#Save the cell type labels in metadata
stromal_obj$new_ann = (mapvalues(
  x = as.character(stromal_obj$harmony_clusters),#map numb as string
  from = names(new_ann),
  to = new_ann
))

 #Convert to factor and drop unused levels
stromal_obj$new_ann <- factor(stromal_obj$new_ann, levels = unique(new_ann))
table(stromal_obj$new_ann)

#11-1 PLOT

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

plt <- DimPlot(
  stromal_obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = "new_ann",   # color by your annotated cell types
  label = TRUE,           # add cluster labels on UMAP
  repel = TRUE,           # avoid overlapping labels
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  labs(color = "Stromal cell type", title = "Cell Type in Stromal Cells") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",                # push legend to the right
    legend.key.size = unit(2, "lines"),       # make colored boxes bigger
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),    # increase text size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),   # increase title size
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)    # center title
  )

plt

#save .choose the width and height according to the output you want.
ggsave(filename = "output/temp/StromalCellType.png", plot = plt, width = 12, height = 8)

#11-1-DOTPLOT WITH THE CELLNAME

##

stromal_markers <- c("FBN1", "PCOLCE2", "CD34",  "PLA2G2A", "SFRP2","CXCL12", "COL15A1",  "PTX3", "TNFAIP6", "CCL2",  "APOE", "APOC1", "AGT",  "CCL19", "CCL8", "CCL21",  "NDUFA4L2", "HIGD1B",  "TNFSF13B", "VCAM1",  "FDCSP", "CXCL13", "CR2",  "SFRP4", "WISP2", "NOV",  "MYH11", "ACTA2", "PLN")
p=DotPlot(stromal_obj, features = stromal_markers, cols = c("lightgrey", "darkgreen"), group.by = "new_ann") +
  RotatedAxis() + ggtitle("Expression of Known STROMAL Markers Across Clusters") +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),  # increase y-axis text
